Reliance Denies Allegations by Subhash Chandra on Media Brands

Reliance Group has denied allegations made by Subhash Chandra concerning its media entities. Chandra had reportedly made allegations regarding media brands within the context of an insolvency row. Reliance has termed these claims as 'baseless'. The dispute involves media brands and an insolvency proceeding.
